claim: Step Functions keeps the execution history of a closed Standard execution for 90 days, and you can reduce this to 30 days by sending a quota request. For an Express workflow you must configure Amazon CloudWatch Logs logging to see the execution history.
question: How long does Step Functions keep the execution history of a closed Standard execution, and can that be reduced?

qualifiers.scope: per closed Standard execution; per account per Region
qualifiers.condition: Reducing to 30 days needs a quota request through the AWS Support Center Console; one request per account-Region combination.
